info.name: AQDI Admin — Complete API
info.description:
All admin APIs in one collection.

**Modules:** Analytics, Employees, Roles, Coupons, Message Alerts

**Variables:** baseUrl, employee_token, employee_id, role_id, coupon_id, message_alert_section_id, message_alert_section_item_id, message_alert_id

**Employees:** use Bearer {{employee_token}} after Login.

request.description: معدل نشاط المستخدمين — `value` نسبة مئوية، `items` فيها active/total users.
Returns `data.token` and full employee in `data.employee`.
Returns full employee: salaries, notes, received_contracts, refundable_contracts.

total = basic_salary - deduction + bonus

Returns `permission_modules` (all sections × actions with `permission_id`), `permission_matrix_template`, `permission_matrix_example`, and `employees`. Syncs missing permissions from config on each call.
Paginated list. Each item includes `permissions_count`, `primary_employee_name`, `updated_at_label`.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "customer_service",
    "title_ar": "موظفة خدمة العملاء",
    "title_en": "Customer Service",
    "description": null,
    "is_active": true,
    "employee_id": null,
    "activate_all_permissions": false,
    "permission_matrix": {
        "employees": ["view", "create"],
        "roles": ["view"],
        "settings": ["view"]
    }
}

request.description: Creates role and syncs permissions from `permission_matrix` or `permission_ids`.
Matches UI toggle: تفعيل كافة الصلاحيات لهذا الدور
Full role with `permissions`, `permission_ids`, and `employees`.
Partial update. Send `permission_ids` or `permission_matrix` only when changing permissions.
Replaces role permissions (sync). Also accepts `permission_ids` or `activate_all_permissions: true`.
Fails with 400 if any employee is still assigned to this role.
All permissions grouped by section — use ids in `permission_ids` or section keys in `permission_matrix`.
Creates `section.action` permission rows if missing (e.g. `analytics.view`).
Sets `is_review` = false (deactivates coupon).
Sets `is_review` = true (activates coupon).
Soft delete: sets `is_delete` = true.
